Feed.author: Pauline E. Spray
Feed.content: Sometimes I feel like I'm running in circles. Just as soon as the kitchen is clean and the dishes are put away, it’s already time to start thinking about the next meal. Does the work ever truly end?

Feed.author: Pauline E. Spray
Feed.content: I spent all afternoon in the kitchen today, but after thirty minutes at the dinner table, there’s nothing left to show for it but dirty plates. It’s hard not to feel a bit discouraged by the temporary nature of all our labor.

Feed.author: Pauline E. Spray
Feed.content: I just finished scrubbing the linoleum on my hands and knees, and not ten minutes later, someone’s already tracked dirt right across the middle. It feels like the world is constantly trying to undo my progress.

Feed.author: Pauline E. Spray
Feed.content: We blunder and make mistakes, and sometimes poor health is our lot for a season. Often we throw up our hands in despair and cry out, 'What's the use?'

Feed.author: Pauline E. Spray
Feed.content: There is hope! God is our helper. I shall not be cast down, but I shall be at rest, for He is the source of my strength and peace. Amen.

Feed.author: Pastor K. A. Shangle
Feed.content: John 3:16 is often heard and we believe it, but do we truly understand its power? It is the Gospel in a nutshell.

Feed.author: Pastor K. A. Shangle
Feed.content: For God so loved the world, that He gave His only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in Him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

Feed.author: Pastor K. A. Shangle
Feed.content: There is no more wonderful announcement in all the Word of God than what we read in this verse. Think of it, beloved! God is love.

Feed.author: Pastor K. A. Shangle
Feed.content: To think that God could love a world that hated Him and demanded the death of His Son. He nailed Him to the cross and mocked Him while He died to redeem even those that hated Him.

Feed.author: Pastor K. A. Shangle
Feed.content: That little word 'so' signifies that there are not enough words in all the languages of the world to explain the depth or the height of the great love God bestowed upon man.

Feed.author: Pastor K. A. Shangle
Feed.content: The truth set forth in the Gospel is that God gave His Son to the world because He so loved the world that whosoever believeth in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.

Feed.content: I just looked at the statistics and food prices have jumped 129% since 1948! No wonder my grocery budget feels so tight lately. Everything is just soaring.

Feed.author: Jim White
Feed.content: Inflation is hitting everything, but ironically, air travel is one of the few things that hasn't propelled upwards at the same rate. It’s almost cheaper to fly than to drive these days!

Feed.author: Merritt Nelson
Feed.content: Gasoline is up 174% and electricity 89%. It’s getting harder and harder for us independent business owners to keep the lights on and the machines running.

Feed.author: Lela Peck
Feed.content: Hospital semi-private rooms have increased 774 percent since 1948. That is an absolutely staggering number. We really need to look at what's happening to our healthcare costs.

Feed.author: William Axford
Feed.content: A big thank you to my coffee dunkin' pals for keeping my spirits up! And to Rev. Hessler for the visits while I was in the hospital. Your kindness means the world to me.
Income tax season is coming! No appointment necessary. Visit me at 11 N. State Street, Sparta. Open Mon-Wed-Fri and Saturdays.

Feed.author: Gary Congdon
Feed.content: Just listed! Ideal for a small family. A 2-bedroom bungalow near town, very nicely decorated. $21,900. Come see it before it's gone!

Feed.author: Concerned Student
Feed.content: If I attend Jordan College or Jordan West, will the credits I earn transfer to other colleges? I want my hard-earned credits to be accepted if I decide to transfer or go on for graduate work.

Feed.author: Jordan West Admissions
Feed.content: Absolutely! Jordan College is a member of a regional accrediting agency and our credits are recognized by major universities like U of M, MSU, and Grand Valley. We even have a C3 rating in the AACRAO Handbook!

Feed.author: Arzie L. Pinckney
Feed.content: We are slowly getting back in the old groove. We had 78 regulars out for a cup of coffee and a donut today with one new recruit. It's so good to see everyone!

Feed.author: Arzie L. Pinckney
Feed.content: We extend our heart felt sympathy to Mrs. Reaman and her family. Bill has been so sick for a long time. We'll certainly miss him at our meetings.

Feed.author: William Axford
Feed.content: I'm feeling much better today, but I'm not quite sure when I'll be back on the job. Thanks to everyone for the well wishes!

Feed.author: Donald E. Kaiser
Feed.content: After nearly 26 years of service, today is my final day with the Michigan State Police. It's been an honor serving the Rockford district and the people of Michigan.

Feed.author: Arden Alexander, M.D.
Feed.content: I'll be speaking on Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (S.L.E.) on January 19th at the new auditorium in But-Muskegon. Please join us for this important discussion on how it affects the body.

Feed.author: Richard L. Saur
Feed.content: We are thrilled to welcome our third son, Andrew James! He arrived yesterday weighing in at 9 lbs. 1/2 oz. Big brothers Christopher and Timothy are so excited.

Feed.author: Sparta Nursery Center
Feed.content: Dad's Day was wonderful! Our little ones were beaming with anticipation. We painted, listened to stories, and shared a delicious snack. Everyone had a great time!

Feed.author: Lois
Feed.content: I am so happy to be crowned Queen for the week! A loss of 2 1/2 lbs—hard work really pays off. Let's keep it up, gals!
SPAGHETTI SUPPER: at the High School Cafeteria. Friday, Jan. 14 from 5 to 7 p.m. Adults $2.00, Children under 12 $1.00.

Feed.author: Helen Maleski
Feed.content: I am so happy to finally share that Craig Johnson and I are engaged! A summer wedding is in the works and I couldn't be more excited for our future together. 💍✨

Feed.author: Henry Good
Feed.content: God has truly blessed our family. Little Barbara Rosalee is finally home with us in Rockford! Angela and Kenneth are so excited to welcome their new baby sister. 9 lbs 4 oz of pure joy! 🙏❤️

Feed.author: Janette Buhl
Feed.content: Reflecting on our trip to Toronto for the Holiday Teen Convention. This was truly the greatest time I’ve ever had, being with so many other kids who feel the same way I do about Jesus Christ. It was worth every mile! #Celebrations #Toronto76

Feed.author: Billy Kenneth Shafer
Feed.content: I am so proud of our seven teens from Sparta Free Methodist who traveled to Toronto over Christmas. Seeing their growth and dedication at the convention was a highlight of my year. You kids represent our church so well!

Feed.author: Kris Anderson
Feed.content: He's here! George and I are so proud to announce the arrival of our first born, Ethan Albert. He’s a big boy at 9 lbs and 22 inches long. Grandma and Grandpa Anderson are already over the moon! 👶💙

Feed.author: Pauline Spray
Feed.content: I am so impressed with our Morning Belles this morning! We are already into January and everyone is keeping their resolutions to lose weight and stay on the ball. We even had two 'best losers' this week—2 1/2 lbs each!

Feed.author: Betty C.
Feed.content: Helen B. and I are off to a great start! We both lost 2 1/2 pounds this week. It feels super to get back on track after the holidays.

Feed.author: Berle
Feed.content: I can't believe I won one of the mystery boxes today! It was such a surprise. Congratulations to me!

Feed.author: Maria B.
Feed.content: Connie S. and I are so happy to be the newest members of the Morning Belles. Everyone has been so welcoming, and I know this club is going to be exactly what I need to stay motivated this year.

Feed.author: Elaine J.
Feed.content: I am so honored to be named the 'best loser' for the months of November and December! It has been a lot of work, but hearing everyone applaud for me and Ardele F. makes it all worth it.

Feed.author: Pauline Spray
Feed.content: Don't forget, ladies—we're having our Bingo game (or TOPS game as we call it) next week! Hope everyone can make it. Also, keep your eyes open for a new contest coming up soon!

Feed.author: Classic Car Owner
Feed.content: Did you see the listing for the auction in Coopersville this Saturday? A 1971 Mustang Fastback with a high speed cam and special carb... that's a dream find right there. I might have to clear some space in the garage.

Feed.author: Loveland Real Estate Agent
Feed.content: Looking for a little more space? I just listed a beautiful 4-bedroom home on 25 acres that is perfectly split. Or, if you're looking for something more manageable, we have a 2-bedroom condo with a garage and a 3-bedroom on an acre with a fireplace. Give me a call in Cedar Springs!

Feed.author: Vera Matteson
Feed.content: I am heading into another shift at the Sparta Nursing Home. It’s hard work, but these residents make every minute worth it. They feel like family to me.

Feed.author: Claude Matteson
Feed.content: Celebrating 10 years of marriage with Vera tonight! Dec. 19, 1967 feels like just yesterday. I am so lucky to have her by my side.

Feed.author: Frank J. Vanden Heuvel
Feed.content: Serving 19 years on the Kent City School Board has been a true labor of love. I'm honored to help shape the future for our local kids.

Feed.author: Jane Vanden Heuvel
Feed.content: Frank is so busy between the Zoning Board and the Ambulance Board, I'm lucky if I see him for dinner! He really loves this community.

Feed.author: Ford J. McBride
Feed.content: Supervisor duty never stops at Kelvinator! I'm keeping the production lines moving today and making sure the crew has what they need.

Feed.author: Joyce McBride
Feed.content: Ford and I have loved our 13 years here in the Kent City area. It’s been a wonderful place to raise our children and build our life together.

Feed.author: William G. Reaman
Feed.content: There is nothing like the view from the cab of my Farm Bureau truck. I've seen every corner of Kent City from this seat over the years.

Feed.author: Cora Reaman
Feed.content: William is finally taking it easy now that he's retired, but he still makes sure to attend all the Sparta Senior Citizens meetings.

Feed.author: Lorrene L. Anderson
Feed.content: Eberhard's is hopping today! I love being the head cashier because I get to catch up with everyone in Sparta while they do their holiday shopping.

Feed.author: John Anderson
Feed.content: I am so proud of Lorrene. Whether she's at the checkout or helping out at Mamrelund, she always puts this community first.

Feed.author: Edward Soderstrom
Feed.content: I am calling the regular meeting of the Village of Sparta to order. We have a full agenda tonight including some important appointments and fund transfers.

Feed.author: Paul Gibson
Feed.content: Just reported to the council on our December activity. We handled 106 traffic violations and 13 non-traffic citations this month. Our officers are working hard to keep Sparta safe.

Feed.author: Leonard Sleutel
Feed.content: Huge news! The President and Council have officially recommended me as a new Policeman for the Village of Sparta. I am honored and can't wait to start serving this community.

Feed.author: Wayne Van Gessel
Feed.content: Grand Rapids, it's good to be back! Fort Leonard Wood was tough but I'm ready to help with recruiting here at the Northtown Shopping Center for the next 30 days.

Feed.author: Fred Chambers
Feed.content: Proud to have PVT Van Gessel joining our recruiting team. He's a top-tier graduate of our training programs and a great example for local Kent City youth considering the service.
Ask The Paint Pro: Flecks of color in your paint? Usually a result of inadequate mixing or an overdosing of colorants. Come see us at the Fuller O'Brien Shop at 2234 Alpine N.W.!

Feed.author: Larry Fogle
Feed.content: Our 1977 Missionary Conference at Rockford Baptist is going to be life-changing. I'm preparing my slides for the Central African Republic presentation! See you on Jan 22.

Feed.author: Clara Nickolie
Feed.content: Cleaning up and getting ready to host the American Legion Auxiliary ladies this Monday. We'll be meeting at 8 PM at my home on Happy End Drive!

Feed.author: Jerry Van Gessel
Feed.content: My boy Wayne is finally home! He's done so well with his heavy equipment repairman training at Fort Leonard Wood. So proud of his service.

Feed.author: Gene Taylor
Feed.content: Just wrapped up the 1976 building permit report. Sparta is growing—24 new village permits were issued last year worth over $209,110. A great year for our village!

Feed.author: Elvin Simons
Feed.content: 185,585,000 gallons of wastewater treated in 1976. It's a dirty job, but someone has to keep our environment clean for the Sparta community.

Feed.author: Albert Hale
Feed.content: We pumped 135,500,000 gallons of water to the people of Sparta this past year. Cheers to a refreshing and successful 1977!

Feed.author: Dave Snyder
Feed.content: Brazil has been an incredible journey. I can't wait to share our mission work with the Rockford Baptist Church community starting Jan 22.

Feed.author: Jack O'Donnel
Feed.content: My wife and I are looking forward to hosting the Senior Citizens Fellowship next Wednesday! Don't forget it's a pot luck dinner at noon. Mr. and Mrs. John VanLoon will be co-hosting with us.

Feed.author: Jack Hough
Feed.content: I am looking forward to our Missionary Conference in Rockford. It's a privilege to share the work we've been doing in Colombia with all of you.

Feed.author: Bob Crockett
Feed.content: Representing the Inter-City work of Chicago at the upcoming Rockford conference. Every soul matters, and I'm eager to share the progress of our mission.

Feed.author: Rockford Youth Leader
Feed.content: Don't miss the youth pizza party on Saturday, Jan 22! Rev. Larry Fogle will be our guest speaker. It's going to be a night of fellowship and inspiration.

Feed.author: Brian Layer
Feed.content: Absolutely on fire tonight against Sparta! Scoring 25 points and shooting 78.5 percent from the floor felt incredible. We're finally in that first-place tie where we belong. #EaglePride #KentCity

Feed.author: Dan Afton
Feed.content: Had to step up in the second quarter when the pressure was on. Picked up 15 points to help us pull ahead with that 20-8 run. Sparta's defense didn't make it easy, but we kept our composure.

Feed.author: Tim Thome
Feed.content: Tough loss tonight. We held our own in the first quarter, but Kent City's shooting was just too consistent in the second. Back to practice tomorrow to work on our transition defense.

Feed.author: Kim Edgar
Feed.content: Taking the plunge into Kent City's Spanish class! It's intense—answering rapid-fire questions or it's a turnover. My head is spinning, but I love the challenge. Adios amigos y bueno suerte! #SpanishClass #KentCityHigh

Feed.author: Harry Kukla
Feed.content: What a night! 23 points to lead the team to a 72-54 win over Grant. We broke that first-period deadlock and never looked back. We're 4-1 now and rolling!

Feed.author: Doug Weston
Feed.content: Harry was unstoppable tonight, but I'm happy with my 16 points and 7 boards. This Grant team is physical—three of their guys fouled out! Glad we out-distanced them in the fourth.

Feed.author: Terry Prickett
Feed.content: Frustrating night in Kent City. Picking up my fifth foul and having to watch the final minutes from the bench is the worst. We've got to play cleaner next time.

Feed.author: Doug Jensen
Feed.content: Tough loss for the J.V. squad against the Spartans. Hit a nice jump shot, but their full court press really rattled us in the second half. 52-36 isn't how we wanted to start the week.

Feed.author: Jim Stebbins
Feed.content: Played my heart out in the first half, but those turnovers in the middle of the action killed us. Scoring 9 points doesn't mean much when you lose to Sparta.

Feed.author: Mr. Schultz
Feed.content: I'm officially starting the Kent City Boxing Club! We've already got members like Ray Nauta and Cary Patton training. Girls are more than welcome too—come try your luck at boxing! #KentCityBoxing

Feed.author: Dale Leichty
Feed.content: Life in the Navy keeps me busy, but I'm grateful to have Diane by my side here in Charleston. It's been a whirlwind few months since we exchanged vows!

Feed.author: Carroll Emmorey
Feed.content: It doesn't feel like 25 years, but the calendar says it's true! Come celebrate with us this Sunday afternoon between 1 and 5 PM.

Feed.author: Mark Emmorey
Feed.content: We're throwing a big party for Mom and Dad's 25th anniversary! My brothers, sisters, and I are hosting an open house this Sunday at Bill and Bev's place. Hope to see you there!

Feed.author: Chris Christopher
Feed.content: Man, another tough loss tonight in Kent City. We were right there in the first half, but just couldn't sustain it in the second. 22 points for me, but the 'W' is all that matters. We've got to find a way to bounce back.

Feed.author: Tom Sheckler
Feed.content: That second half really got away from us in Kent City. It's frustrating because we know we can play with these teams. We need to stay focused for all four quarters.

Feed.author: Tim Thome
Feed.content: Keep your heads up boys. Coopersville is coming up this Friday and it's time to get back in the win column. Let's show them what Spartan basketball is all about! #SpartanPride

Feed.author: Nick Lewis
Feed.content: Hard fought game against the Belding Redskins last night. 73-60 doesn't reflect how aggressive we played. I managed to chip in 12, but we need more consistency as a unit.

Feed.author: Doug McCotter
Feed.content: Scored 10 and grabbed 6 rebounds against Belding. We're showing flashes of brilliance, just need to put it all together for the full game.

Feed.author: Sparta Fan
Feed.content: When will it all end? Another bitter defeat for our Spartans. They stay so close but just can't seem to close it out in the second half. Hoping for better luck against Coopersville.

Feed.author: Kent City Eagle
Feed.content: Huge 60-48 win over Sparta tonight! We really turned it on in the second half to pull away. Great team effort by all the guys. Go Eagles!

Feed.author: John Andrus
Feed.content: Sparta Freshmen win! 49-44 over the Belding Redskins. That's our 7th win of the season and we're feeling great. 4-1 in the conference now!

Feed.author: Justin Sullivan
Feed.content: 17 rebounds and 13 points tonight. Felt like every ball off the glass was mine. Great win tonight, team!

Feed.author: Dan Lockard
Feed.content: Pulled down 10 rebounds in our win over Belding. They kept it close all night, but we never let them get more than five points away. Proud of this squad.

Feed.author: Sparta Frosh Fan
Feed.content: Our freshmen are looking unstoppable! Great win over the Redskins tonight. These guys are showing so much heart on the court.

Feed.author: Belding Frosh Player
Feed.content: Tough loss to Sparta tonight. We fought hard and kept it within five most of the night, but they just had a bit more at the end. We'll get them next time.

Feed.author: North Kent Leader Editor
Feed.content: What an incredible milestone! We are honored to be named a 'Centennial' business by the Historical Society of Michigan. This newspaper has been serving the community since J.W. Hallack founded the Sentinel in 1876. Here's to another 100 years!

Feed.author: Tony Vasilauskas
Feed.content: Just got word that I'll be recognized at Blodgett tomorrow for donating over 5 gallons of blood. It’s a simple thing to do, but it makes such a difference. See you there, neighbors!

Feed.author: Sparta Middle Student
Feed.content: Our class is out here every day working on the giant snow sculpture! It's massive. We're just praying this 'January thaw' everyone is talking about doesn't melt our masterpiece before we're finished.
Calling All Valentines! Surprise your loved ones with a photo in the North Kent Leader. Just $4.00 per snapshot for our Feb 9th edition. Don't forget your favorite Valentine!

Feed.author: Dan Cheslek
Feed.content: Proud to represent the Sparta Lions Club today. We just turned over a $400 check to Larry Ofield for the Blodgett Burn Unit. These funds come directly from our community pancake breakfast proceeds!

Feed.author: Larry Ofield
Feed.content: A huge thank you to Dan Cheslek and the Sparta Lions Club. This $400 will go a long way for the fund drive at the Blodgett Burn Unit. The support from Sparta is truly inspiring.

Feed.author: Elinor Olin
Feed.content: Reminder: The Sparta Chamber Annual Meeting is next Thursday at the Greenville City Club! I have tickets available here at Sherry's, or you can grab them at Sparta State Bank. It's going to be a great night of dinner and dancing.
Moose Lodge Weekend: Friday Fish Fry ($2.25), Saturday Steak Dinner ($4.95), and Sunday Breakfast. Open to members and invited guests!

Feed.author: Grand Valley Blood Program
Feed.content: January is National Voluntary Blood Donor Month. We are so proud of our donors in Comstock Park and Conklin. Join us tomorrow at Blodgett Medical Center as we recognize Tony Vasilauskas, Richard Sedlecky, John Thomas, Carl Wollen, and Charles Johnson for their life-saving contributions.

Feed.author: Sparta Art Teacher
Feed.content: I am constantly amazed by the creativity of my students. Utilizing natural materials like snow and ice to build something of this scale is a lesson they'll never forget. Their dedication is staggering.
Plan ahead for February! Ladies Shirt Jac and Man's Shirt classes starting soon. We also have openings for Country Painting and Macrame classes. Call 887-7765.

Feed.author: Mixed Company Band
Feed.content: We're ready to rock the North Kent Eagles this Saturday night! Come out for live entertainment and dancing from 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM. See you there!

Feed.author: Pauline E. Spray
Feed.content: To be able to lie down in safety is the Christian's privilege. Fear is an unpleasant thing, yet many are afraid of the perils in the night. I always recall the childhood prayer: 'Now I lay me down to sleep...' Let us pray to rest in the wonder of His love today.

Feed.author: Jim Wisnewski
Feed.content: Marie and I are incredibly proud to announce that God has blessed our family with a new son! Thomas Benjamin arrived New Year's morning, weighing 9 lbs. 6 oz. He was anxiously welcomed by his big brother Jimmy and his six sisters!

Feed.author: Marie Wisnewski
Feed.content: Our little Thomas Benjamin is doing wonderfully. Having our second boy born on New Year's morning at Blodgett Memorial Hospital was quite a start to 1977! The grandparents are just thrilled.

Feed.author: Vivian Reyburn
Feed.content: Don't forget the Chili Supper for our Singles Caring and Sharing group! It's this coming Saturday at 6:30 p.m. right here at my place on Elmwood. Just a free will offering, and we're planning an old-fashioned sleigh ride soon too!

Feed.author: Marjorie Lake
Feed.content: It was so wonderful meeting new people at our Singles Coffee in Grand Rapids last Sunday. If anyone wants more info on our upcoming events, including the chili supper, give me a call!
